headline: Pennsylvania would let Attorney General penalize frontier developers
text:
Here is how your fear of AI is being used to centralize power today.

Pennsylvania would give the Attorney General the power to penalize frontier developers that fail to address critical incidents and catastrophic risks from their models. Not passed. It cites the fear that AI might get away from the people running it.

71 measures in 20 jurisdictions would create an AI office, or hand an existing one new authority over AI or data centers.

161 measures in 42 jurisdictions cite the fear that anyone can now fake anyone.

2,065 measures tracked. 670 carry a control, and they would hand new power to 64 offices.
